name: BMS Fault Response Time
description: Response time of the Building Management System to a detected fault. Checks whether alarm response meets safety requirements.

elements.name: Fault-to-Alarm Response Time
elements.description: Time from fault detection to operator alarm. Uncertain due to network load and polling cycle variation.

elements.name: Maximum Alarm Response Time
elements.description: Facility management SLA for critical fault alarms

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(t_bms) = t_detect + t_network; F = [1 1], f = [0] (sum of two independent latency components)
consistency_relations.upr_description: Total BMS response time is the affine sum of fault detection latency and network delivery latency: t_bms = t_detect + t_network. This parametric mapping aggregates two independent uncertainty sources into the total response time, which must not exceed the 20 s SLA.
